correctness.rationale: An exact projected-ellipse-plus-opposing-apices hull formula yields two elementary branches. Its derivative is governed by the strictly increasing H(t)=(1+t²)atan(t)/t, with H(0+)=1, proving all extrema, unique inverse branches and transitions. Exact Taylor expansions yield the quarter-power and square-root endpoint exponents and coefficients, while the tangent-segment cubic expansion gives the three-halves contact. Cauchy mean agrees. The 432 deterministic numerical diagnostics (fine polygonal hull, derivative, mean, boundary, and optimizer checks) passed; none are used as a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The full isotropic brightness distribution of a symmetric circular bicone is a naturally motivated classical convex-geometric statistic beyond the mean shadow area. The two independent exact aspect-ratio thresholds and quartic critical contact produce a genuinely distinct rare-event exponent 1/4, together with an exact inverse-function CDF and tangency boundary-layer singularity. These are meaningful geometric classifications rather than a routine one-off substitution.
